text:
marta: customer on Dedicated behind a corporate proxy is reporting duplicate POSTs hitting their backend. They see an ECONNRESET and then our TS SDK issues a retry, creating duplicate DB rows. Node 20.6.1, @redwood/inference 1.9.2. Any ideas?

liam: can you drop a minimal repro + exact Node/npm output? Is the proxy doing CONNECT tunneling or interception (TLS MITM)? Also confirm whether the app sets any idempotency header.

marta: proxy is Squid doing TLS inspection (not plain CONNECT). Minimal snippet: 
```
const ctrl = new AbortController();
await client.fetch('/v1/items', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  signal: ctrl.signal,
});
```
No idempotency header set. Customer says duplicates only when proxy in-path and network hiccup triggers a connection reset.

kevin: ECONNRESET during write -> if the server didn't ack the request, retry will cause duplicate. undici sometimes treats socket resets as retriable. The question: does our retry logic treat POST as safe to retry?

liam: I inspected fetchWithRetries in the SDK. During the global fetch refactor we accidentally widened the retry predicate to "non-fatal network errors" without gating by method. So POSTs got retried. That would explain the two different X-Request-Id values in our ingress logs.

marta: customer reported 12 duplicates in their batch run. They need a mitigation now.

liam: immediate mitigation options: 1) ask them to add an idempotency header: `X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` so server can dedupe; 2) set env var `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_POSTS=false` to disable POST retries on their runtime; 3) update proxy keep-alive/pooling to avoid mid-request resets (longer timeouts) but that's heavier.

elaine: which SDK release will contain the fix and ETA?

liam: patch plan: revert retry predicate so only idempotent methods are retried (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/PUT/DELETE) OR allow POST only when `X-Idempotency-Key` present. Add a debug log at decision point: `sdk: not retrying POST without idempotency-key`. We'll cut 1.9.3 with the change today and publish a backport for Dedicated customers if they need a pinned build.

dev-bot: CI triggered for release/1.9.3 (build 1.9.3-beta).

kevin: docs follow-up: add KB about proxies doing TLS inspection, how it can cause mid-write resets, and recommended server-side dedupe + client idempotency keys. Also add a support checklist for collecting undici/SDK debug logs (DEBUG=undici, REDWOOD_DEBUG=1) and X-Request-Id checks.

marta: I'll pass the two immediate mitigations to the customer (idempotency key + env var). Please ping when 1.9.3 is published and we'll validate with their QA run.

liam: will do. thanks for flagging this quickly :thumbsup:
